BiblicalUsage: tûwgâh is the word the Bible uses when it means grief, sorrow. In Psalms 119:28, My soul melteth for heaviness, and it appears again in Proverbs 10:1.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tûwgâh exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
